evals.prompt: How do I use the new React Server Components with Next.js app router? Show me the current API.
evals.expected_output: First resolves the library ID (e.g., /vercel/next.js) using resolve-library, THEN queries docs with that ID. Does not skip the resolve step or guess the library ID.

assertions.name: resolves-library-id-first
assertions.description: Calls resolve-library-id (MCP tool or CLI script) to search for the library BEFORE querying docs — does not hardcode or guess the Context7 library ID

assertions.name: queries-docs-with-resolved-id
assertions.description: After getting the library ID from resolve, calls query-docs (MCP tool or CLI script) with that ID and a relevant query about server components/app router

assertions.name: returns-code-examples
assertions.description: Response includes actual code examples from the Context7 documentation, not just descriptions from general knowledge

evals.prompt: I need the API reference for iced (the Rust GUI framework). What widgets are available and how do I create a button with an on_press handler?
evals.expected_output: Resolves 'iced' to its Context7 library ID first. Then queries for button/widget documentation. Returns current API signatures, not outdated ones from training data.

assertions.name: resolves-iced-library-id
assertions.description: Calls resolve-library-id with 'iced' (or 'iced-rs') to find the correct Context7 library ID — does not assume the ID

assertions.name: queries-for-button-widget-docs
assertions.description: Queries Context7 docs specifically about button/widget/on_press — not just generic 'iced' documentation

assertions.name: uses-context7-not-training-data
assertions.description: Response cites or includes documentation snippets from Context7, not just reciting from training data knowledge of iced

evals.prompt: What's the correct way to set up Convex schema validation with v.object and v.string? The docs I found online seem outdated.
evals.expected_output: Resolves Convex library ID via Context7. Queries for schema validation docs. Returns up-to-date API with current function signatures. Handles large doc blocks appropriately (summarizes or delegates if >100 lines).

assertions.name: two-step-resolve-then-query
assertions.description: Performs the two-step Context7 flow: (1) resolve-library-id for 'convex', (2) query-docs with resolved ID — both steps are explicit

assertions.name: schema-specific-query
assertions.description: Query to Context7 is specific to schema/validation (mentions v.object, v.string, schema, or validators) — not a generic 'convex' query

assertions.name: handles-large-docs-appropriately
assertions.description: If Context7 returns a large documentation block (>100 lines), summarizes or uses the summarize-file script rather than dumping raw docs into context
